annotation.title_clean: Directive 2004/26/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 21 April 2004 amending Directive 97/68/EC on measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Directive 2004/26/EC amending Directive 97/68/EC on emissions of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 146
annotation.summary_en: EU directive amending Directive 97/68/EC, setting staged (IIIA, IIIB, IV) emission limits and test procedures for diesel engines in non-road mobile machinery, including rail and inland waterway engines. Introduces transient test cycles, defeat-device bans, flexibility scheme and labelling. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Stage IIIA, IIIB and IV emission limits for CO, HC, NOx and particulates by engine power category
Extends scope to railcar, locomotive and inland waterway engines
Prohibits defeat devices and irrational emission control strategies
Introduces NRTC transient test cycle and durability requirements
Flexibility scheme for OEMs with labelling; Commission review by end 2007
